items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I played In Essen, Germany at a festival there where he was on the bill and I used to talk with him

ctx.x: Yes. A lot of people went over and played with them.
I played In Essen, Germany at a festival there where he was on the bill and I used to talk with him, you know, but I never did play, I was supposed to have played with his band in '68.

Well, you've probably had more experience in Europe than most American musicians who've been over there because I mean you lived there a long time. Did you find a short of big difference in the audiences as compared with those here?
